# js-aruco browser scripts

Source: https://github.com/jcmellado/js-aruco

Pinned commit: `2203d4b5efb601c39054a341bf04702409699383`. Browser distributions with line endings and trailing whitespace normalized; see LICENSE.txt.

The npm 0.1.0 src files previously loaded by Plickers require CommonJS and throw `module/require is not defined` in browsers. These upstream browser scripts provide the existing `CV` and `AR.Detector` globals.
